rooms.name: High Temple of the Avian Sun God
rooms.desc:
Carved out of beautiful white marble and sandstone, the temple appears as 
inviting as it does foreboding.  The entrance is marked by a pair of exquisite 
marble doors embossed with hieroglyphs depicting the valor of the avian nobles 
and their faithful.  Unfortunately, the marble doors seem to be permanently 
sealed, preventing adventurers from entering the sacred realm.

rooms.name: End of the Path
rooms.desc:
The strange chanting intensifies as the dirt trail begins to fade into an
open clearing.  The trees in the forest open up allowing the sun to shine
on a large sandstone structure in the distance.  The forest seems very
peaceful here, almost similar to the calm before a storm.

rooms.name: Tako-Ethreina
rooms.desc:
An extremely large, majestic tree stands before you.  It is the largest tree
you have ever come across in your life.  The tree has a powerful, mystical
aura about it one you cannot quite discern.  Scampering all about the tree
are all sorts of small woodland creatures, seemingly at home in its branches.

rooms.name: A Path through the Trees
rooms.desc:
Light barely reaches the ground floor of this forest because the foliage is
so thick.  Somehow the shrubbery manages to flourish despite the lack of
sunlight.  A constant barrage of wild animal sounds echoes throughout the
forest along with several other strange noises.

rooms.name: A Hidden Utopia
rooms.desc:
Sunlight illuminates the forest as the canopy becomes less dense.  The
land here is amazingly fertile.  Lush trees and plants blossom out of the
earth sheltering all sorts of wildlife.  A mother bear and her two cubs
passed by recently as indicated by the paw prints in the dirt.  The woods
seem more serene than before, almost as if the forest is inviting you to stay.

rooms.name: A Sandstone Staircase
rooms.desc:
As you near the end of the staircase it appears that all the sounds of a forest
come alive at once.  It brings back memories of the deep woods near Kir'Draxin.
Off in the distance you can see a family of deer leaping thru the woods and
squirrels playing in the trees.  It seems like the area itself is at peace.

rooms.name: A Sandstone Staircase
rooms.desc:
A staircase appears to have been carved right out of the sandstone cliff wall.
It seems to extend all the way down into the valley of the ravine, which is
strangely filled with lush trees and plants.

rooms.name: A Forgotten Trail
rooms.desc:
The overgrowth on the trail makes the path much more difficult to follow.
A dim light from the west brightens the earth enough to see.  A long, colorful
snake slithers through the tree roots garnishing the earth.  Termites and other
small bugs flood the area, thriving on a fallen tree that has begun to rot.

rooms.name: A Forgotten Trail
rooms.desc:
Sunlight fails to penetrate the canopy now as the only sources of light are
the beady white eyes of nearby animals.  The path is marked only by the
gaps between the towering oak trees.  Scavengers crowd the forest in
anticipation of something, or someone, dying.

rooms.name: A Forgotten Trail
rooms.desc:
The deeper the faded dirt trail leads into the forest, the less sunlight that
escapes through the canopy and shines on the ground.  The sound of birds 
chirping fades and is replaced by eerie shrill noises and high-pitched howls.  
The ambience of this forest grows more foreboding as the path leads farther 
into the forest.

rooms.name: A Forgotten Trail
rooms.desc:
A faint dirt path winds through the underbrush of the forest.  No one has
taken this path in a long time as evident by the tree roots and shrubbery
growing over the trail.  The shrill howl of a wolf pierces the calm of the
forest and provides an ominous pretense as to where this path leads from.

rooms.name: The Halls of Order
rooms.desc: The walls and ceiling are covered in great detail with heiroglyphics depicting  an epic struggle against a powerful demon and its armies.  From deeper within   the pyramid you hear shuffling and a low moaning sound.

rooms.name: Pyramid Interior - Ground Floor
rooms.desc: The walls and ceiling are covered in great detail with heiroglyphics depicting  an epic struggle against a powerful demon and its armies.  From deeper within   the pyramid you hear shuffling and a low moaning sound.

rooms.desc: This arena you can tell is used for highly intense training, there are weapons  of all types in the racks along the walls.  There are also straw dummies posted at intervals and a wrestling pit for melee combat.

rooms.name: Quest Storage Room
rooms.desc:
Darius's room to store quest mobs for Casica.  If you are here and you aren't
Immortal you might be dead.

rooms.name: A Lush Forest Path
rooms.desc:
The forest continues to gleam as the canopy opens up even more to reveal
the flourishing underbrush.  Rabbits and other small mammals scurry through
the brush and search the bushes for nuts and berries.  Several species of birds
line the upper branches of the trees as their song fills the air.

rooms.name: A Small Clearing
rooms.desc:
The forest opens up as a small stream trickles down a creek bed.
Beautiful flowering plants line the edge of the creek while several large
rocks allow the path to continue across the water.  The sound of running
water combined with the lighthearted song of the birds makes this path
through the forest seem peaceful, for now.

rooms.name: A Bend in the Path
rooms.desc:
The dirt trail comes to a dead end at the base of a giant oak tree as the
path fades away.  The shrubbery is even denser in this area and covers up
all sorts of wildlife living on the ground level.  A small gap in the trees to
the west reveals a new path that is even more overgrown.

rooms.name: A Path through the Trees
rooms.desc:
Tree roots and undergrowth cover the path as it winds between the trees.  
Branches and tree limbs hang over the path making it difficult to navigate.  A 
small clearing exposes a hollowed out tree stump that looks like a good place 
to rest.

rooms.name: An Overgrown Path
rooms.desc:
The path is very overgrown here, hinting that this area may not have been
used in many years.  Trees grow in an odd way here, obscuring your view
of the trail ahead.  It dawns upon you that this is most unnatural, perhaps
great magics were used.  Small woodland creatures scamper about playfully,
uncaring about the oddity of the woods.  Meanwhile a mysterious chanting
resonates throughout the forest.

rooms.name: An Overgrown Path
rooms.desc:
Several massive tree branches have fallen in such a way as to impede travel.
The forest itself appears to make the life of explorers quite harsh.  The signs
of wildlife and vegetation have disappeared almost completely.  The strange
noises echoing through the forest grow louder and it becomes clear that they
are some sort of ritualistic chanting.

rooms.name: An Overgrown Path
rooms.desc:
The path winds around a cluster of great poplar trees and heads back off into
the lush forest while the sun shines bright through the trees and lights up the
abundant canopy.  The sounds of wildlife and birds fade tremendously as the
strange chanting noises amplify.

rooms.name: A Lush Forest Path
rooms.desc:
The path is less overgrown here, hinting that this area may have been used 
recently by someone, or something.  Being in full bloom, the trees and bushes 
provide a picturesque image of this lush forest and the thriving environment.  
Small woodland creatures scamper about playfully, seemingly enjoying their 
place in the forest.  Meanwhile, a mysterious, enchanting song begins to
resonate throughout the forest.

rooms.name: A Lush Forest Path
rooms.desc:
Several luscious fruits and berries adorn the various trees and bushes
along the path.  In the dirt, rabbit tracks lead to a small hole in the ground
where a family of rabbits gathers berries for storage.  Strange noises echo 
through the forest and grow louder and it becomes clear that they are some
enticing songs of battles long past, sang by numerous enchanting voices.

rooms.name: A Lush Forest Path
rooms.desc:
The path winds around the great tree and heads back off into the lush 
forest.  The sun shines bright through the trees and lights up the abundant
greenery.  The sounds of wildlife and birds fade slightly as the enchanting
songs begin to amplify.

rooms.name: The Forest Gates
rooms.desc:
Here stand two massive gates that stand twelve feet high and ten feet wide.
They appear to be formed directly out of the forest by magic of some kind.
Behind the gates you can see what appears to be a small encampment teeming
with activity.

rooms.name: Path through the Elven Encampment
rooms.desc:
Several sets of footprints moving in every direction are impressed all over
the earth.  The sounds of movement echo throughout the encampment but
there are no visible signs of life.  Perhaps the sounds are just a figment of
your imagination running wild.  To either side are large, silken tents in which
you can see numerous signs indicating a sizeable number of stationed troops.

rooms.name: Path through the Elven Encampment
rooms.desc:
A large fire pit burns brightly here with some meat on a spit.  There are
logs set as benches around the fire for nighttime tales and songs.  The air
about the camp feels jovial and friendly.

rooms.name: A Small Elven Tent
rooms.desc:
A fabulously woven, silk tent has been erected here.  Inside are all types
of things to lessen the wear on morale due to travel.  There are six cots set
up along the sides of the tent.

rooms.name: A Small Elven Tent
rooms.desc:
A fabulously woven, silk tent has been erected here.  Inside are all types
of things to lessen the wear on morale due to travel.  There are six cots set
up along the sides of the tent.

rooms.name: Central Building Entrance
rooms.desc:
A massive canvas door blocks your way into this huge officers' tent.
The sounds coming from within indicate planning towards a campaign.
A constant sense of movement around you leaves a feeling of being watched.

rooms.name: Elven Quartermaster Tent
rooms.desc:
Helmets, shields, and numerous suits of armor all crafted out of a strange
durable, yet lightweight metallic material are arranged on numerous racks.
The sounds of a small forge and anvil hard at work can be heard throughout
the shop.  The tent itself is one of the larger ones in the camp.  It is also
constructed out of a very durable silk-like material.

rooms.name: Elven Quartermasters Tent
rooms.desc:
Weapons of all sorts hang from the walls of the shop.  They are all made
out of this strange material that is extremely durable and holds a razor edge
longer than normal metal.  The sounds of a small, busy forge can be heard
coming from the back of the shop.  The tent itself is one of the larger ones
in the camp.  It is also constructed out of a very durable silk-like material.

rooms.name: Inside the Commanders' Tent
rooms.desc:
Heavily-armed soldiers scan the perimeter of this tent searching for
intruders while soft whispers coming from the rear of this tent disclose
secret battle formations and siege tactics.  An uneasy feeling trembles
up your spine as the sound of a blade sharpening catches your ear.

rooms.name: Inside the Commanders' Tent
rooms.desc:
Barrels full of food and supplies are stacked in this corner of the tent.
The stench of a freshly killed boar emanates from one of the crates, filling
the room with a blood tainted aroma.  The smell alone could ward off any 
unwarranted visitors.

rooms.name: Inside the Commanders' Tent
rooms.desc:
This corner of the tent appears to be used for weapons storage used by
the general himself.  A rack with several heavily-used blades rests against
the wall while an assortment of shields lays strewn across the base of the
tent.  Soldiers footsteps pound the ground as they continue to guard the area.

rooms.name: General Tenelar's War Room
rooms.desc:
Stacks of elongated rolls of parchment lie scattered upon the floor.  One
long piece of parchment is tacked to a board, hanging from two ropes along
the back wall.  Majestic scripting covers what appears to be a map of the
area, on which numerous small figures have been strategically placed.

rooms.name: Inside the Commanders' Tent
rooms.desc:
This area of the tent has been turned into a design studio for different
types of siege engines.  Blueprints of battering rams, catapults, and siege
towers lay stacked on a small table and adorn the walls.

rooms.name: Inside the Commanders' Tent
rooms.desc:
A small wooden shelf stands in the dirt here, filled with several
manuscripts, books, and other documents.  This appears to be where
the general stores the historical texts he references when forming his
future siege tactics.
